matchedPathReference: Fixed accepted share quantities/timing; previous close to current open gap PnL plus current open to close PnL at fixed FX. Equals final equity plus recorded fees/tax/slippage. Not an independent signal benchmark, cost-free rerun or same percentage exposure.
limitations: Retrospective diagnostics on already observed frozen prices; no parameter selection/optimization
2026 observations reserved and not used in this run; this is not out-of-sample significance evidence
Three correlated selected ETFs; calendar/corporate-action coverage not independently verified
Same original 2023Q1 quantity including original 10bp cost-buffer sizing, frozen across both costs and every quarter; target15% differs from actual integer-share exposure
Quarter reset rows are separate10000000KRW accounts, never summed or compounded into continuous performance

filterSemantics.cumulative: Current observation versus buy_days observations earlier, inclusive >=1pct
filterSemantics.atr: Same native delta >=0.5 x arithmetic mean of14 true ranges from15 prior completed daily OHLC, current candidate OHLC excluded; zero/insufficient is entry-not-ready
filterSemantics.trend: Candidate strictly greater than mean of200 prior completed daily closes
filterSemantics.combination: Each candidate alone. Multiple configured entry filters AND, but no combination tested in this study
filterSemantics.live: Quote observations remain distinct from refreshed completed daily OHLC context; entry-only, existing exit and shared guard/risk preserved

defaultCompatibility: Predeclared correction of two consecutive observation-unit reason labels only; including preservation of the exact known terminal unfilled suffix; all other report/signal fields remain comparable. No default filter enabled or live config changed.
